repos_data.description: FlashFlags is an ultra-fast, zero-dependency, lock-free command-line flag parsing library for Go. Originally built for Argus, it provides great performance while maintaining simplicity and ease of use.

WARDEN — MCP security firewall: vets an MCP server's tool definitions against static-scan rules, a signed threat feed, origin and tool-def pinning before any tool reaches the model. Zero-dependency TypeScript library.
